detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Understory 1.1 is now out!

Changes included:
- left arrow now goes back in the navigation history, making left/right navigation through your note trees much more natural
- selecting multiple notes now shows all the selected notes in the note viewer so that you can read through them as a narrative
- made focus appearance more obvious to note viewer and side panel

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/understory-zettelkasten-notes/id6796801720
#mac #productivity #zettelkasten
